config_source: backend .env with existing process environment taking precedence

queries.identity: SELECT DATABASE() AS database_name, VERSION() AS version, @@session.tx_read_only AS transaction_read_only
queries.size: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scopus_documents
queries.schema: SELECT TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,COLUMN_TYPE,IS_NULLABLE FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME IN ('scopus_documents','scopus_document_authors','scopus_authors','scopus_affiliations','scopus_source_metrics') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION LIMIT 300
queries.indexes: SELECT TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,NON_UNIQUE,SEQ_IN_INDEX,COLUMN_NAME FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME IN ('users','scopus_documents','scopus_document_authors','scopus_authors','scopus_affiliations','scopus_source_metrics') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,SEQ_IN_INDEX LIMIT 300
queries.documents: SELECT sd.id,sd.eid,sd.scopus_id,sd.raw_json,sd.author_role_status,sd.author_role_checked_at,COALESCE(YEAR(sd.cover_date),CAST(RIGHT(sd.cover_display_date,4) AS UNSIGNED)) AS year_ce,(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scopus_document_authors sda JOIN scopus_authors sa ON sa.id=sda.author_id JOIN users u ON TRIM(u.scopus_id)=sa.scopus_author_id JOIN scopus_affiliations aff ON aff.id=sda.affiliation_id WHERE sda.document_id=sd.id AND u.delete_at IS NULL AND u.is_test=0 AND u.scopus_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(u.scopus_id)<>'' AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(aff.name,''))) IN ('khon kaen university','faculty of science, khon kaen university'))) AS faculty FROM scopus_documents sd ORDER BY sd.id LIMIT 100000
queries.links: SELECT sda.document_id,sa.scopus_author_id,sda.author_seq,sda.is_first_author,sda.is_corresponding_author,aff.afid,aff.country, (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE TRIM(u.scopus_id)=sa.scopus_author_id AND u.delete_at IS NULL AND u.is_test=0 AND TRIM(u.scopus_id)<>'')) AS registered, (LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(aff.name,''))) IN ('khon kaen university','faculty of science, khon kaen university')) AS kku FROM scopus_document_authors sda JOIN scopus_authors sa ON sa.id=sda.author_id LEFT JOIN scopus_affiliations aff ON aff.id=sda.affiliation_id ORDER BY sda.document_id,sda.author_seq LIMIT 1000000
queries.catalogue: SELECT afid,country,name FROM scopus_affiliations ORDER BY afid LIMIT 100000
queries.cohort_diagnostics: SELECT COUNT(*) AS users_active_non_test, SUM(role_id IN (1,4,5)) AS faculty_roster_users, SUM(scopus_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(scopus_id)<>'') AS users_with_scopus_id, SUM(scopus_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(scopus_id)<>'' AND role_id NOT IN (1,4,5)) AS non_roster_users_with_scopus_id FROM users WHERE delete_at IS NULL AND is_test=0
queries.employment: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sda.document_id) AS cohort_documents,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.date_of_employment IS NOT NULL AND sd.cover_date < DATE(u.date_of_employment) THEN sd.id END) AS documents_with_preemployment_eligible_author,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.role_id NOT IN (1,4,5) THEN sd.id END) AS documents_with_non_roster_eligible_user FROM scopus_documents sd JOIN scopus_document_authors sda ON sda.document_id=sd.id JOIN scopus_authors sa ON sa.id=sda.author_id JOIN users u ON TRIM(u.scopus_id)=sa.scopus_author_id JOIN scopus_affiliations aff ON aff.id=sda.affiliation_id WHERE u.delete_at IS NULL AND u.is_test=0 AND TRIM(u.scopus_id)<>'' AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(aff.name,''))) IN ('khon kaen university','faculty of science, khon kaen university')
queries.explain_cohort: EXPLAIN SELECT sd.id FROM scopus_documents sd WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scopus_document_authors sda JOIN scopus_authors sa ON sa.id=sda.author_id JOIN users u ON TRIM(u.scopus_id)=sa.scopus_author_id JOIN scopus_affiliations aff ON aff.id=sda.affiliation_id WHERE sda.document_id=sd.id AND u.delete_at IS NULL AND u.is_test=0 AND u.scopus_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(u.scopus_id)<>'' AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(aff.name,''))) IN ('khon kaen university','faculty of science, khon kaen university')) AND COALESCE(YEAR(sd.cover_date),CAST(RIGHT(sd.cover_display_date,4) AS UNSIGNED)) BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026

transaction: REPEATABLE READ; READ ONLY; consistent snapshot; ROLLBACK on exit
